subject: Portfolio expansion: add 5 apps, revise term & API key rollout
messages:
From: Samir Khanna <samir@novacorp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-01T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Quick: expand to five more apps this quarter

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks again for the demo last week. We want to accelerate and onboard five additional internal apps into the same tenant: claims-invoice, intake-bot, search-ranking, docs-assist, and retention-wizard. High level asks: new API keys per app (staging + prod), a short canary window (30 days), and a contract amendment to reflect the temporary higher unit consumption in Q1.

Can you send an SOW and a proposed timeline so we can align procurement? Ideally live for canary by the second week of January.

Also looping in Elena (security) for any compliance questions.

Thanks,
Samir
Samir Khanna
Head of Platform
Novacorp
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khanna <samir@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-02T11:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: expand to five more apps this quarter

Samir —

Great to hear Novacorp is ready to scale. Draft plan below and attached initial SOW (Novacorp_Rollout_SOW_v2.pdf). Please confirm forecasts and any hard constraints.

Proposed timeline
- Dec 7 — confirm usage forecasts & required key matrix (you)
- Dec 9 — Redwood to provide amendment draft + key naming matrix
- Dec 16 — receive signed amendment (DocuSign) or redlines
- Jan 6 — staging keys provisioned; 30-day canary begins
- Jan 20 — production keys provisioned if canary OK

Requests for you
- Estimated monthly token/embedding consumption per app for Jan–Mar
- Any compliance evidence Elena needs (SOC2/retention policy)
- Which teams need admin vs read-only keys

Marissa I’ve looped you for rollout support and to coordinate the key matrix / onboarding runbooks. Logan please prepare a pricing amendment (we can discuss a +20% commit for Q1 to smooth capacity).

Attachments: Novacorp_Rollout_SOW_v2.pdf

Cheers,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-03T09:28:00-08:00
Subject: Fwd: Re: Quick: expand to five more apps this quarter

Forwarding Evelyn’s plan — quick notes from enablement side:

- Recommended key cadence: one staging key + one prod key per app, plus two shared admin keys for their Infra and Data teams. We should provide an example API_KEY matrix (see attached).
- Canary tooling: we can enable request-level tracing and per-route throttles to isolate noisy calls during the 30-day window. Alex, can you confirm we can create the per-app routing and a temporary cache partition for each app?
- Playbook: run a dry-run with 2 apps in staging by Jan 3 to validate playbooks before full canary.

I’ve attached an example matrix (api_key_matrix.xlsx) and a bonehead redline to the SOW (amendment_redline_20261207.docx).

-Marissa
Customer Enablement
From: Samir Khanna <samir@novacorp.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Elena Martins <elena.martins@novacorp.com>
Date: 2026-12-08T14:45:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: expand to five more apps this quarter

Evelyn / Marissa —

Thanks for the fast turnaround. We reviewed the SOW and matrix; a few points from procurement/security:

- We need 10 staging keys and 5 production keys initially (we’ll rotate to per-app keys after canary).
- Novacorp requests a 30-day canary (fine) and a 45-day extended trial for the first app (Retention-wizard) while product confirms data quality.
- For Q1 forecast: we anticipate ~1.2M tokens/month aggregated across the five apps with a 20–25% spike during peak tests. We are open to a +20% committed units amendment for Jan–Mar as you suggested — please put numbers in the contract.

Elena: SOC2 artifact request — retention policy and audit-log sampling.

We’ll review redlines and send formal markups by Dec 12.

Samir
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.com>
To: Samir Khanna <samir@novacorp.com>, Elena Martins <elena.martins@novacorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-12-15T16:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick: expand to five more apps this quarter — amendment & keys

Samir / Elena —

Appreciate the confirmation. We’ve done the internal updates and attached the redline (amendment_redline_20261207.docx) with the +20% Q1 commit and the key counts you requested. Next steps:

1) I’ve created the DocuSign amendment and shared the link below — please countersign by EOW Dec 20 so we can hit Jan 6 for staging provisioning.
2) Marissa will provision the 10 staging keys and 5 production keys once we see the signed amendment; she’ll also push the onboarding runbooks to your team.
3) Alex will enable per-app routing and the cache partitions for canary isolation.
4) Elena — we attached retention policy excerpts and an audit-log sampling doc in the Drive link; flag if you need additional evidence.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/prepare/Doc12345-novacorp-amendment
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/deal/4521
Drive: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c_rollout_plan

Attachments included: Novacorp_Rollout_SOW_v2.pdf; api_key_matrix.xlsx; amendment_redline_20261207.docx

If signed by Dec 20 we will schedule the dry-run for Jan 3 and provision staging keys on Jan 6.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Director, Customer Success — Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | https://redwood.ai
